notes: disable-model-invocation is set, so no prompt can route here: every case is a behaviour case and run-evals.py skips them until a fixture and a judge exist.

evals.name: speculative-abstraction-is-cut
evals.expected_output: Two fresh readers are dispatched in one message. A PaymentProvider interface with one implementation and a provider-config table that no story exercises are cut; the leaf that built them is merged into its neighbour, edges and Files: are rewired, tech-design.md is trimmed in the same pass, and the gate lists the cut with the leaf that still meets each story it touched.

evals.name: requirement-backed-complexity-is-kept
evals.expected_output: The spec's ADR accepts an outbox for payout events. A reader proposes replacing it with a direct call; the finding is recorded as kept, naming the ADR consequence, and the outbox leaf, its idempotency constraint and its tests stay in the plan unchanged.

evals.name: half-built-plan-gets-a-simplify-phase
evals.expected_output: Phases 1-6 are ticked. The explorer reads the landed code and finds a hand-rolled retry policy that duplicates the existing RetryTemplate, and Phase 8 (unbuilt) would build on it. Phases 1-6 keep their numbers, titles and ticks. A new 'Simplify' leaf is numbered 7, depends on the frozen leaves it touches, carries their story names in Implements:, keeps the landed tests' assertions unchanged, and the unbuilt leaves are renumbered above it with the old-to-new map reported.

evals.name: taste-only-built-code-gets-no-phase
evals.expected_output: Landed code in a ticked phase is verbose but nothing unbuilt builds on it and it carries no defect risk. No Simplify leaf is added; the report names the code and points at /r:code-refactor.

evals.name: reuse-rewrites-a-leaf-without-file-line
evals.expected_output: The explorer finds an existing CurrencyConverter that does what Phase 9 plans to build. After the code is read and its semantics confirmed, the item is rewritten to use it by type name, Files: drops the new file, and no file:LINE reference appears in the plan.

evals.name: no-agent-tool-blocks-rather-than-reviewing-inline
evals.expected_output: In a context with no Agent tool the skill stops with blocked: no-agent, writes nothing, records mode blocked, and does not review the plan itself in the same context.

evals.name: embedded-in-spec-design-before-codex
evals.expected_output: After pass 3 and before the Codex challenge, spec-design follows plan-simplify over its draft: the readers run, outcomes are verified, the draft is simplified in place, and the applied/kept/dismissed/question lists appear at spec-design's single gate. Nothing is written before that gate and plan-simplify records no row of its own.
